intents.description: Issues related to iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS updates, installation errors, system bugs, boot loops, or lag after an OS update.
examples: Ever since I updated to iOS 11.1 my iPhone has been freezing constantly.
My iPad won't finish downloading the latest software update. It gets stuck on verifying.
How do I downgrade back to iOS 10? The new update ruined my battery and keyboard.

intents.description: Complaints regarding battery drain, degradation, unexpected shutdowns, slow charging, or overheating.
examples: My iPhone 7 battery drops from 80% to 20% in less than an hour of normal use.
Phone suddenly turned off with 30% battery left and won't turn back on without charging.
Is there a battery replacement program for iPhone 6s? My battery health is at 72%.

intents.description: Apple ID login problems, password reset, two-factor authentication (2FA), locked or disabled accounts, and account recovery.
examples: My Apple ID has been locked for security reasons and I can't receive the verification SMS.
Forgot my Apple ID password and the recovery email is an old address I no longer have access to.
Keep getting prompted to enter Apple ID password repeatedly every 5 minutes.

intents.description: App Store purchase issues, unauthorized credit card charges, refund requests, subscription cancellations, or payment method declines.
examples: I was charged $9.99 for a subscription I cancelled during the free trial. How can I get a refund?
Why was my card charged twice for an App Store game purchase?
My payment method was declined but my card has sufficient funds. Please help fix my billing info.

intents.description: Problems connecting to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth devices (AirPods, Apple Watch), cellular data dropping, or 'No SIM' errors.
examples: My iPhone keeps saying 'No SIM Card Installed' even though the SIM is inside.
AirPods keep disconnecting during calls every 2 minutes.
Wi-Fi toggle is greyed out in settings and I cannot connect to any wireless network.

intents.description: Physical device issues including cracked screens, unresponsive touchscreens, camera glitches, microphone/speaker failures, or physical damage repair queries.
examples: The touchscreen on my iPhone 8 isn't responding to touches at the bottom corner.
My rear camera only shows a black screen when opening the camera app.
How much does it cost to replace a cracked iPhone X screen at the Apple Store?

intents.description: iCloud backup failures, storage full alerts, photos not syncing across devices, contacts missing, or data transfer between iPhones.
examples: My iPhone won't complete an iCloud backup because it says not enough storage available.
Photos taken on my iPhone are not syncing to my Mac via iCloud Photo Library.
Trying to transfer my data from my old iPhone 6 to my new iPhone 8 using iTunes backup.

intents.description: General how-to questions, device compatibility, warranty status, AppleCare inquiries, and standard product information.
examples: How do I enable Screen Recording in Control Center on iOS 11?
Can I trade in my iPhone 6s towards the purchase of a new iPhone 8 in store?
How do I check if my MacBook is still covered under AppleCare warranty?
